english.note: Use this when the variation is specifically in colour rather than in the types of things mixed together.

examples.english: The temple fair entrance is hung with motley lanterns, which look beautiful at night.
examples.traditional: 廟會門口掛滿五顏六色嘅燈籠，夜晚好靚。
